assignments.reason: This node represents feeling the taste of sweetness in Torah — the practice side of the eitza. Its essential nature is Torah-sweetness, which the teaching explicitly equates with דבש (honey) via the verse 'מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִי'. The sweetness one feels in Torah IS the bechina of honey; it belongs to the same essential domain as דבש in Package 1. Polarity is good: feeling sweetness in Torah is a holy practice aligned with kedusha.

assignments.node_id: להנצל מענש של אלמן, שלא תמות אשתו, חס ושלום
assignments.reason: This node represents being saved from the punishment of widowhood — the effect side of the eitza. Its essential nature concerns the protection of one's wife (אשה), which is the second node of Package 1. The teaching's mechanism works precisely because דבש = אשה: the sweetening domain (honey) and the protected domain (wife) are ontologically identical. This node is the concrete manifestation of the אשה side of Package 1. Polarity is good: salvation from a harsh decree is a positive, holy outcome.
